newsitem.title: USA: Forest Labs files NDA for Citalopram.
newsitem.headline: Forest Labs files NDA for Citalopram.

text.p: Forest Laboratories Inc said Monday that it had filed a new drug application with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for Citalopram, a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor for treating depression.
Citalopram is approved and marketed in 49 countries by H Lundbeck A/S of Copenhagen. Forest licenses the compound from Lundbeck.

"We expect to achieve a significant share of the U.S. market and provide the necessary support to enable the product to reach the sales levels its desirable profile justifies," a statement from Forest said.
